document.abstract: In commercial motion picture production, there is often a need for both 35-mm and 16-mm color prints. In this field color serves the purpose of product identification, and therefore a three-color system is required. In the specific work described here, locations were widespread and demanded specific dates for shooting. Therefore, several cameramen had to cover location assignments almost simultaneously and available 35-mm professional photographic equipment had to be used. How both 35-mm and 16-mm color release prints were quickly processed from one three-color original is described.
